gv_IndPrem.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT 'DTL' AS DETAIL,NULL AS BGBG_ID,NULL AS BGBG_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,   MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,   GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,NULL AS ASM,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,   SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,   SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS STATE,   SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,   TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('3/23/2024','mm/dd/yyyy'),1),'MM'),'YYYYMMDD') AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,   CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT-1 =  (SELECT MEPE_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('3/23/2024','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT)         THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NEW_ENROLL,PLDS.PLDS_DESC, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT FROM   FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME     ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE     ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK     AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'       AND TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('3/23/2024','mm/dd/yyyy'),1),'MM') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR     ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD     ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD     ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK      AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS     ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID    WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL','FAML') AND ROWNUM<=10'

Fallout_Query.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT BLEI.BLEI_CK,SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,     GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,     SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,    SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,    SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,    SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,    SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS STATE,    SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,    TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RAD.Fallout_Date))||TO_CHAR(EXTRACT( MONTH FROM RAD.Fallout_Date))||'01' AS BLBL_DUE_DT,  PLDS.PLDS_DESC,  MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT  FROM AGP.RAD_FALLOUT RAD JOIN    FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_ID = RAD.SBSB_ID    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME      ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE      ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK      AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'        AND TRUNC(Fallout_Date) BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR      ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD      ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK      INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI       ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK          AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD      ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK       AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS      ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%''

scripts.text:
UPDATE A SET A.BASE_RATE = B.BASE_RATE,A.BILLED_AMT = ISNULL(B.BILLED_RATE,0)+ISNULL(B.ME_SURCHARGE,0),
A.AGE = B.AGE_FROM
FROM [BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_I_WS_IN] A JOIN 
[BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_I_WS_OUT] B ON
A.SBSB_ID = B.HCID AND A.GRGR_ID = B.GROUP_ID AND A.CSCS_ID = B.CLASS_ID AND A.CSPI_ID = B.PLAN_ID AND B.BILLED_RATE_IND='Y' 
AND REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.BASE_RATE_EFF_DT,102),'.','') = A.PREM_RATE_START_DT

UPDATE A SET A.BASE_RATE = B.BASE_RATE,A.BILLED_AMT = ISNULL(B.BILLED_RATE,0)+ISNULL(B.ME_SURCHARGE,0),
A.AGE = B.AGE_FROM
FROM [BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_II_WS_IN] A JOIN 
[BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_II_WS_OUT] B ON
A.SBSB_ID = B.HCID AND A.GRGR_ID = B.GROUP_ID AND A.CSCS_ID = B.CLASS_ID AND A.CSPI_ID = B.PLAN_ID AND B.BILLED_RATE_IND='Y' AND REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.BASE_RATE_EFF_DT,102),'.','') = A.PREM_RATE_START_DT


UPDATE A
SET A.AGE = CASE WHEN A.AGE = B.AGE AND A.LETTER_TYPE ='AA' THEN B.AGE-1 ELSE A.AGE END
FROM [BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_II_WS_IN] A JOIN 
[BOSS].[Letter].[PREM_CA_I_WS_IN] B ON A.SBSB_ID = B.SBSB_ID

UPDATE A 
SET A.LANGINSRTSTATE = B.LangId 
FROM LETTER.PSDOUT A  
JOIN [Letter].[Language_Insert] B  
ON CASE WHEN A.GROUPID LIKE '%SUP000' THEN  'SUP000' ELSE A.GROUPID END = B.LANGST AND  A.BATCHID = @BatchId 

DELETE FROM LETTER.PSDOUT WHERE BATCHID=@BatchId AND (LANGINSRTSTATE IS NULL OR LANGINSRTSTATE = '')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LETTER.PSDOUT 
WHERE BATCHID = @User::BatchId

'SELECT DISTINCT BLEI.BLEI_CK,SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,

   GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE, 

  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,

  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,

  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,

  SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,

  SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS STATE,

  SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,

  TO_CHAR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM RAD.Fallout_Date))||TO_CHAR(EXTRACT( MONTH FROM RAD.Fallout_Date))||'01' AS BLBL_DUE_DT,

PLDS.PLDS_DESC,

MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT

FROM AGP.RAD_FALLOUT RAD JOIN

  FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_ID = RAD.SBSB_ID

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME

    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE

    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK

    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'

      AND TRUNC(Fallout_Date) BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR

    ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = MEPE.GRGR_CK

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD

    ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 

    ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 

       AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD

    ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 

    AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE

INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS 

   ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID

   WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%''
